inbox.draft.brief_hint: Tell the AI what the reply should say, for example the times you can meet. It reads the conversation and the lead’s details too.
inbox.draft.drafting: Drafting a reply. It takes a few seconds.
inbox.draft.failure.checks: The AI’s reply did not pass the checks, for example it named something that is not in the conversation or the lead’s details. Add what it should say to the brief and try again.
inbox.draft.failure.lead: This lead or this conversation could not be read for a draft. Write the reply yourself.
inbox.draft.failure.other: Something stopped the draft. Try again.
inbox.draft.failure.stuck: The draft took too long and was stopped. Try again.
inbox.draft.ready: The AI’s draft. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
inbox.draft.stuck: The draft is taking longer than usual. Try again to keep waiting.
inbox.draft.title: Draft with AI
inbox.empty.no_sender: No replies yet: you have no LinkedIn account connected. Connect yours, and the replies to your own messages show here.
inbox.errors.classifier_agent_not_loaded: A reply could not be classified. The sequence to its sender stays stopped.
inbox.errors.inbox_file_invalid: A reply could not be read. The sequence to its sender is stopped.
inbox.errors.inbox_message_not_found: This message is not in your inbox.
inbox.errors.message_not_inbound: Only a reply can be labeled: this message was sent from your account.
inbox.errors.person_suppressed: This person cannot be contacted: they opted out, or they or their company are on the never-contact list. Nothing is sent to them.
inbox.errors.reply_brief_too_long: The brief is too long: keep it under 2,000 characters.
inbox.errors.reply_channel_unavailable: This conversation’s LinkedIn account is disconnected, or the lead cannot be reached on it. Connect the account again on the LinkedIn page to reply.
inbox.errors.reply_text_invalid: Write a reply, no longer than this conversation’s channel takes.
inbox.errors.thread_not_found: This conversation is not in your inbox.
inbox.errors.week_invalid: This week cannot be exported: its year has no such week, or it has not started yet.
inbox.label.opt_out_confirm: The person is never contacted again, on any channel, and an opt-out cannot be undone. Label this reply as opted out?
inbox.label.opt_out_stays: The person stays opted out: an opt-out is never lifted, whatever this reply’s label.
inbox.list.caption: Conversations, newest first
inbox.list.description: Only the conversations the platform started appear here, newest first. Open one to read it and reply.
inbox.list.empty: No replies yet. When the platform starts a conversation, it shows here.
inbox.list.error: The conversations could not be read
inbox.list.name: {first} {last}
inbox.list.scope: The replies to your own LinkedIn accounts: each member reads only their own conversations.
inbox.list.title: Inbox

inbox.reply.label: Your reply
inbox.reply.placeholder: Write your reply. It goes out from your account, in this conversation.
inbox.reply.reason.day_used: The account’s LinkedIn limits for today were used up, and a reply is not kept for later. Send it again tomorrow.
inbox.reply.reason.other: Something stopped it on the way. Send it again to try once more.
inbox.reply.reason.outside_working_hours: It was outside the account’s working hours, or a weekend, and a reply is not kept for later. Send it again within the account’s working hours.
inbox.reply.reason.refused_by_linkedin: LinkedIn refused it: the account and the lead may no longer be connected, or the lead’s profile is unavailable.
inbox.thread.empty: No messages in this conversation yet.
inbox.thread.error: The conversation could not be read
inbox.thread.owner_only: Only the owner of this conversation’s account replies to it.
